description: This file defines utility classes for thread-safe, lock-free, multi-producer single-consumer buffers aimed at high concurrency scenarios. It includes classes like StripedMpscBuffer and MpscBoundedBuffer, along with supporting utilities for bit operations and padding for cache line alignment.

classes.name: StripedMpscBuffer<T>
classes.description: Provides a striped bounded buffer that employs multiple internal buffers to scale linearly with the number of concurrent threads, using thread IDs and hashing for distribution and contention management.

classes.name: MpscBoundedBuffer<T>
classes.description: Implements a multi-producer, single-consumer thread-safe ring buffer with fixed capacity, supporting lock-free add and drain operations.

classes.name: BufferStatus
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the status of buffer operations such as success, full, empty, or contended.

classes.name: BitOps
classes.description: Contains static utility methods for bit manipulation, including mixing bits and computing the next power of two.

classes.name: PaddedHeadAndTail
classes.description: Struct to hold head and tail indices with padding to avoid false sharing via cache line alignment.

classes.name: Padding
classes.description: Utility class defining cache line size constants for padding purposes depending on architecture.

methods.name: TryAdd
methods.description: Attempts to add an item to the buffer in a thread-safe manner, returning a status indicating success, contention, or fullness.

methods.name: DrainTo
methods.description: Drains items from the buffer into an array or span, returning the number of items drained.

methods.name: TryTake
methods.description: Attempts to remove an item from the buffer in a thread-safe manner, returning a status and the item via out parameter.
